Returns the item count of the item in the given inventory slot.
Takes a slot number to point to an inventory slot.
Returns '0' when not in a world or the slot is empty.

Returns the key of the active effect for the given index.
Takes a zero-based index for the effect to get.
The index of the first effect is 0.
Returns an empty value when not in a world or
when no active effect exists for the given index.

Returns the key of the hovered item in the currently open inventory.
Returns an empty value when no inventory is open or no item is hovered.

Returns the key of the item in the given inventory slot.
Takes a slot number to point to an inventory slot.
Returns an empty value when not in a world.

Returns the largest integer less than or equal to the given number.
For example, floor(3.14) = 3 and floor(-3.14) = -4.

Returns the last world or server the player joined.
You can control via the 'type' value if the placeholder
should return both servers and worlds or only one of them.

Types: both, world, server

The 'full_world_path' value controls if the full path or
only the name of the world (not server) should get returned.
Setting this to 'false' will only return the world name.

Returns the max absorption health of the player.
Returns '0.0' when not in a world.

Returns the max armor of the player.
Returns '0.0' when not in a world.

Returns the max food level of the player.
Returns '0.0' when not in a world.

Returns the max health of the player's mount.
Returns '0.0' when not in a world or not riding an entity with health.

Returns the max health of the player.
Returns '0.0' when not in a world.

Returns the max oxygen level of the player.
Returns '0.0' when not in a world.

Returns the name of an active boss.
Takes a zero-based index for the boss you want to get the name of.
The first boss has and index of 0.
Also takes a boolean (true/false) if the name should be returned as JSON.
Returns an empty value when not in a world or no boss with the given index is active.

Returns the negation of the given number.
If the given number is negative, the given number is returned.

Returns the paused state of a Video element.
Returns 'true' when the element is paused, otherwise returns 'false'.

Returns the paused state of a Video menu background by its identifier.
Returns 'true' when the element is paused, otherwise returns 'false'.

To get the identifier of a background, right-click the
editor background and click on 'Copy Background Identifier'.

Returns the player's view direction.
Returns an empty value when not in a world.
Possible Values: north, east, south, west

Returns the seed of the current world.
Returns an empty value if no world is loaded or the seed is not available.

Returns the size of a local file in bytes.
Only supports local files, not URLs.
Returns 0 if the file doesn't exist or cannot be read.

You can target the default '.minecraft'
directory by starting the file path with '.minecraft/'.
Returns the smaller of two numbers.

Returns the smallest integer greater than or equal to the given number.
For example, ceil(3.14) = 4 and ceil(-3.14) = -3.
Returns the time since the game launched in seconds or, if "output_as_millis" is true, in milliseconds.

Returns the total armor toughness value of the player.
Returns '0.0' when not in a world.

Returns the total count of an item type in the player inventory.
Takes the key of the target item to search for.
When the target is empty, it counts all item types.
Returns '0' when not in a world.

Returns the total duration of a Video element in MM:SS format (e.g. '03:45') or in milliseconds.
Returns '00:00' or '0' if the element is not ready yet or no video is set.

Required values:
- element_identifier: The ID of the Video element to get the duration from
- output_as_timestamp: Set to 'true' to show milliseconds instead of MM:SS

Returns the total duration of a Video menu background in MM:SS format (e.g. '03:45') or in milliseconds by its identifier.
Returns '00:00' or '0' if the background is not ready yet or no video is set.

Required values:
- background_identifier: The ID of the Video background
- output_as_timestamp: Set to 'true' to show milliseconds instead of MM:SS

To get the identifier of a background, right-click the
editor background and click on 'Copy Background Identifier'.

Returns the total duration of the current track
playing in an Audio element in MM:SS format (e.g. '03:45').
Returns '00:00' if no audio is playing.

Required values:
- element_identifier: The ID of the audio element to get the duration from
Returns the trigonometric cosine of an angle.
Returns the trigonometric sine of an angle.
Returns the trigonometric tangent of an angle.

Returns the volume of a Video element.
The volume is a decimal between 0.0 (0%%) and 1.0 (100%%).

Returns the volume of a Video menu background by its identifier.
The volume is a decimal between 0.0 (0%%) and 1.0 (100%%).

To get the identifier of a background, right-click the
editor background and click on 'Copy Background Identifier'.

Returns the volume of an Audio element
as a value between 0.0 (0%%) and 1.0 (100%%).
Takes the element identifier of the target Audio element.

Returns the width in pixels of the given text.
Useful for calculating element positions or sizes based on text width.
Returns to the previous track in an Audio element's playlist.

Returns true for as long as the specified mouse button is held down.
Use 'left' or 'right' to select the button.

Returns true if an item is hovered in any inventory screen.
For example, the player inventory or a chest.
Returns false if no inventory is open or no item is hovered.

Returns true if any screen is open.
For example, this will return false if the user is walking around in a world, because then there's no screen open.
It will return true if the Inventory or Pause screen is open.

Returns true if the cursor is holding an item in any inventory screen.
Returns false if no inventory is open or the cursor isn't holding an item.
Returns true when FancyMenu's Modpack Mode is enabled.

Returns true when the customization menu bar is visible.
Returns false if Modpack Mode is enabled or the menu bar is disabled.
